status: synthetic proposal for independent review; no implementation or gate result
assumptions: No proposed worker, private endpoint or runtime decoder is implemented.
Case descriptions and private field spellings are review notation, not adopted wire DTOs.
Future executable tests must independently challenge expectations and record the implementation/runtime/resource tuple.
scope: R02/R14; private framing, peer binding, decoding and typed outcomes

cases.setup: Authenticated private connection with no negotiated assignment
stimulus: Public or EA1 namespace at private worker endpoint
cases.expect: Reject before assignment/reduction/dispatch; no fallback to another namespace
cases.evidence: Raw transport trace plus unchanged canonical state/receipt facts

cases.setup: Four-byte big-endian private payload length; valid synthetic payload
cases.stimulus: Every split of a short prefix/payload, empty reads and two coalesced complete frames
cases.expect: Exactly one decode per complete frame; no partial-frame operation or split-induced semantic event
cases.evidence: Transport-partition integration with fixed operation/event identities

cases.expect: Reject or close under bounded policy without reduction/dispatch; oversized prefix does not allocate its declared buffer
cases.evidence: Allocation instrumentation and raw framing negatives

cases.setup: Duplicate detection before generic maps; decoded key comparison
cases.expect: Reject every duplicate at every object depth before map/DTO decoding loses it
cases.evidence: Raw bytes must reach the future decoder; JSON.parse alone cannot test this

cases.setup: Finite private decoder review tuple; root container counts as depth 1
cases.expect: A well-formed at-limit shape still needs semantic/resource admission; reject one-beyond before over-budget allocation/dispatch
cases.evidence: Charge actual capacity, receive buffer, key tracking, escaped expansion, DTO copies and checked representation overhead; include aggregate reservations

cases.setup: Escaped long strings/keys, nested arrays and attacker-declared counts
cases.stimulus: Small encoded representation demands over-limit expanded strings, collection/allocation work or integer arithmetic
cases.expect: Stop at the charged bound with no integer wrap or prevalidation oversized allocation
cases.evidence: Peak/transient allocation counters and fail-allocation injection, not schema acceptance alone

cases.setup: Owned runtime directory and service-launched worker
stimulus: Wrong peer identity with same socket path
cases.expect: Refuse unsafe endpoint/identity and prevent capability leak; same unrestricted UID remains a stated residual limit
cases.evidence: Isolated endpoint/launch tests under declared runtime profile; no hostile same-UID isolation claim

cases.setup: New worker/controller assignment for session incarnation B
stimulus: Result for session incarnation A or foreign stream epoch
Unassigned session, wrong profile tuple or stale committed cut
cases.expect: Reject before publishing a frame, applying core mutation or proposing a current reply
cases.evidence: Late-result/reconnect fault trace with exact identity/cut comparison

cases.setup: Worker/app launch with explicit inherited-FD allowlist
cases.expect: No unintended inherited capability; reject ancillary/number-as-FD paths; report bounded exec failure separately from successful launch
cases.evidence: Inspect disposable child/worker FDs and exec status-channel behavior

cases.setup: Schema-valid public request mapped through service to private/core types
cases.expect: Wire shape does not authorize effects; typed exact-range/core/authority checks refuse at their own boundary
cases.evidence: Service/worker mapper negatives plus unchanged last committed state

cases.setup: Operation may already have reached keeper final queue
cases.expect: Typed transport/cancellation stage stays separate from exact-prefix/unknown delivery receipt; no retry/rollback inference
cases.evidence: Receipt/keeper interleavings rather than string-matching an error

cases.setup: Malformed payload contains synthetic secret-like text and bootstrap capability marker
cases.stimulus: Decode error, timeout and diagnostic logging at every level
cases.expect: Only bounded sanitized code/opaque identity/queue metadata; no payload/key echoes, argv/environment or derived Debug dumps
cases.evidence: Inspect emitted errors/logs; capture remains separately authorized
